_comment: Defaults for flightsim-viewer. Read from <exe>/../config/viewer.json, which
is this file in both the build tree and an installed package. Command-line
flags override anything set here; anything omitted here keeps the built-in
default. Run the viewer with --help to see the flags.
imagery: satellite | osm | bing | none | a {z}/{x}/{y} URL template.
elevation: terrarium | none | a {z}/{x}/{y} URL template.
tileCache: where downloaded map assets are kept. Empty means the shared
per-user cache in %LOCALAPPDATA%\flightsim\tilecache, which every build
and every package on the machine share - so the Earth is already there
the first time you start. Set it to "../maps" to keep the tiles inside
this package instead: fill that with bin/tile_prefetch and the package
carries its own terrain and flies with no network, at the cost of
downloading a region again. See maps/README.md.
offline: draw only what is in tileCache and never fetch a tile.
The packaged copy of this file is generated with offline true and
tileCache ../maps, so a distributed viewer opens no sockets at all.

camera._comment: zoomToCursor is osgEarth's zoomToMouse: the wheel zooms towards the pointer.
